$comment: High and critical npm advisories that are knowingly accepted, checked by scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs.
An entry is only legitimate when no forward fix exists: if npm offers a non-breaking upgrade, take the upgrade.
Every entry needs a reason that says why the advisory is not reachable in this product, and an expiry.
The gate fails once expires passes, once the advisory reaches a dependent outside dependents,
and once the advisory stops being reported at all -- so entries cannot quietly outlive their justification.

exceptions.reason: Docusaurus uses image-size only during the static documentation build to read repository-local image dimensions. The deployed site does not run the Node build service, and this repository has no ICNS, JXL, or HEIF assets. npm reports no forward fix for image-size@2.0.2. Reassessment is tracked in issue #92.
exceptions.review: Before expiry, check Docusaurus, @docusaurus/mdx-loader, and image-size for a compatible patched release, rerun the website audit, and remove this exception when a fix exists; otherwise obtain an explicit new expiry decision in issue #92.
